CustomField.description: Icon for the Extraction stage status (tick = Passed, cross = Failed, warning = Needs Review, clock = In Progress).
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(Extraction_Status__c), "Passed", IMAGE("/resource/DNAMS_Icon_Passed", "Passed", 20, 20), "Failed", IMAGE("/resource/DNAMS_Icon_Failed", "Failed", 20, 20), "Needs Review", IMAGE("/resource/DNAMS_Icon_Needs_Review", "Needs Review", 20, 20), "In Progress", IMAGE("/resource/DNAMS_Icon_In_Progress", "In Progress", 20, 20), "")
CustomField.label: Document Reading
